desc:
Your shift has begun. Memorize every room, spot anomalies, and report them before whatever lurks in the shadows notices you.

👁️ DON'T LOOK AWAY

Every detail matters. A misplaced object, a turned off light, or a shadow that moves on its own, report it immediately. Miss too many anomalies, and your shift ends permanently.

🤝 SOLO OR CO-OP

Take on contracts alone, or monitor the feeds together with friends.

🚨 NEW LOCATIONS & ANOMALIES COMING SOON

New cases and surveillance sites are currently in development. Like the game and join the X Core Studios group to stay updated on future content drops and submit your own terrifying ideas!

Solo-developed passion project. Thank you for playing and supporting the game!

Controls & Tips:

[Shift / L2 / Double Tap] Zoom | Headphones Recommended
